common.discovery: A little more room to create
common.footer: PicZip runs image compression locally in your browser.

resize: The right dimensions, every time. Resize by pixels or percentage, one image or a whole batch.
convert: Convert between JPG, PNG and WebP. Set image quality, choose a background and download your batch.
stitch: Turn a few images into one story. Arrange, space and join them horizontally or vertically.

comparison.title: Less size. Still a clear view.
comparison.description: Drag the divider to explore the same photo before and after compression.
comparison.note: Real sample · JPG → WebP · quality {quality}. Both images are {width} × {height}. Results vary by image and settings.
comparison.alt: Before and after comparison of a bay, mountains and red-roofed houses
comparison.label: Before and after compression

home.title: Free image compressor
home.description: Compress JPG, PNG and WebP to a target size, adjust quality, and download your results individually or as a ZIP.
home.helpText: Start with a target size. If the result is still too large, try reducing the width or switching formats.
home.faqDescription: Answers about file size, quality, formats and downloads.
